system.flavor: A standard-design semi-automatic 12-gauge riot shotgun feeding from a five-round tube magazine on blowback. Steel barrel, receiver and magazine; matte-black Sortex stock and forearm.
system.notes:
Corporate Report 2020: Corpbook 3 pp.30-31 (PDF idx 30-31) text layer: SHT 0 L C 4D6(00) 5/9 2 ST 50m. Printed prices: 400eb basic, 25eb per magazine, 50eb per barrel, 50eb for the extended magazine, +400eb smartchipped.

The 5/9 magazine cell is the five-round tube or nine rounds with the four-round extension (which cannot be used with the quick-change replaceable tubes). Blackhand's Street Weapons p.22 (PDF idx 23), citing [Corpbook 3], prints the concealability cell as J/N (the folding-stock model hides under a longcoat).
